content: Relevant coursework: Machine Learning (CS 540/760), Deep Learning (CS 762), Linear Algebra (MATH 340), Probability (MATH 431), Natural Language Processing (CS 769)

work_experience.title: Machine Learning Engineering Intern
content: Built a retrieval-augmented question-answering service over 40,000 clinical policy documents using Python, LangChain and pgvector.
Split documents into 500-token chunks, embedded them with an open-source embedding model, and tuned top-k retrieval on a 200-question labeled set, raising answer accuracy from 61% to 78%.
Wrote and versioned the system prompts and few-shot examples, and added a check that refused answers when no retrieved passage supported them.
Served the model behind a FastAPI endpoint in Docker on Azure Container Apps, with request logging and latency alerts.
Tracked every evaluation run in MLflow with the prompt version, retriever settings and scores.

work_experience.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
content: Fine-tuned a 7B open-source language model with LoRA on 12,000 labeled support tickets using PyTorch and Hugging Face PEFT on two A100 GPUs.
Built the train, validation and test splits by customer to avoid leakage, and compared the fine-tuned model with a zero-shot baseline on macro F1 (0.71 vs 0.52).
Wrote an Airflow pipeline that pulled new tickets nightly, removed duplicates and personal data, and rebuilt the training set.

projects.name: Course-Help Agent
content: Built a tool-using agent that answers course logistics questions by calling a calendar API and a syllabus search tool.
Logged each tool call and wrote 50 test conversations to catch wrong tool choices before each change.

projects.name: Image Classifier from Scratch
content: Implemented a two-layer neural network with backpropagation in NumPy, then a ResNet-18 in PyTorch on CIFAR-10 reaching 92% test accuracy.
Ran a learning-rate and weight-decay sweep and used early stopping on validation loss.

projects.name: Churn Prediction Features
content: Engineered rolling-window usage features in SQL and pandas for a public telecom dataset, and trained gradient-boosted trees in scikit-learn.
Used 5-fold cross-validation and reported ROC AUC of 0.86 with a calibration plot.
